body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Parrot, a company in wireless peripherals for mobile phones, unveiled the first quadricopter using augmented reality: Parrot AR.Drone at CES 2010.

With a very intuitive mobility and universal accessibility, Parrot AR.Drone is piloted initially with an iPhone or iPod touch and allows you to take a spectacular flying journey. In addition to the pure pleasure of flying, this unique quadricopter enables to recreate a large number of video games in the real world.

Streaming video on the iPhone or iPod touch screen enables you to pilot the AR.Drone as if you were sitting in the pilot's seat; the image processing allows to integrate real-time special effects of augmented reality.
